drifted.actual: Trigger-based fix already present in working tree; force_flush invokes installed FlushTrigger and blocks. Spec text stale; interface durability still unverified under testing/spdk.

drifted.spec_text: MockBlockDevice provides deterministic fault-injection testing supporting SC-002/SC-003.
drifted.actual: MockBlockDevice impl IBlockDevice does not implement read_write_stats (trait requires it), so the testing/spdk test build does not compile; persistence and SSD tests cannot run.

drifted.spec_text: Unit/persistence/SSD tests, clippy, and docs are exercised by cargo/CI.
drifted.actual: Crate is absent from root Cargo.toml members/default-members; CI never builds or tests it.

drifted.spec_text: Test MUST use the standard IExtendedMetadataStore interface, not internal APIs.
drifted.actual: Store creation and durability use inherent/internal APIs (initialize_from_client, snapshot_entries, mark_flushed, load_entries, flush::flush_to_disk); consequence of FR-05 no-op history.

drifted.spec_text: Capacity exhaustion surfaced to the caller; test_capacity_exhaustion expects a put()-level capacity error.
drifted.actual: put() enforces only ValueTooLarge; capacity is a flush-time String error inside flush::flush_to_disk, never mapped to CapacityExhausted, so the test passes trivially without reaching the exhaustion branch.
